insight: Indexes video into spatiotemporal embeddings rather than captioning frames, so you search a library by what happens on screen, not tags.
name: Twelve Labs
tagline: Video understanding API. Search and reason over footage.
description: A video intelligence platform whose models turn raw footage into searchable, reasoned-over content. Marengo produces multimodal embeddings for natural-language search across a video library; Pegasus reasons over the full timeline to summarize, classify, and answer questions. Offered as an API and SDK with a web playground.

modelSupport.notes: First-party proprietary video models — Marengo (embeddings) and Pegasus (video-language).
